{
  "architect_scope": "one-R30-structural-factor-only",
  "proposal_mode": "counter_hypothesis",
  "qualitative_hypothesis": {
    "observed_bottleneck": "The complete predecessor closure carries presumptive positive semantic authority, so terminal reconciliation can preserve correlated blind spots instead of independently challenging inherited commitments.",
    "causal_change": "Invert only the predecessor edge's authority polarity: retain full executable-artifact visibility but make the closure disconfirming evidence rather than a semantic starting point.",
    "expected_effect": "The terminal call should independently ground its semantics in public evidence while using the visible closure to expose unsupported commitments, changing both predecessor deference and construction timing.",
    "falsifier": "all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score"
  },
  "structural_mutation": {
    "change_count": 1,
    "factor": "unconditional negative-evidence polarity of the predecessor executable-closure edge",
    "before": "The final call treats the predecessor closure's current semantics as the positively authoritative starting state for reconciliation.",
    "after": "The final call sees the same complete closure only as disconfirming evidence and grants semantic authority solely to commitments independently grounded in its other visible inputs.",
    "why_structural": "This changes the causal authority of the sole inter-call edge without changing call count, artifact completeness, or external-input visibility; it is unconditional edge semantics rather than role renaming or conditional revocation."
  },
  "mode_certificate": {
    "rejected_assumptions": [
      "A complete executable predecessor should be presumptively authoritative at policy emission.",
      "Preserving executable-lineage visibility requires positive inheritance of predecessor semantics.",
      "Terminal reconciliation should begin from the predecessor's semantic commitments."
    ],
    "forbidden_inherited_mechanism": "presumptive positive semantic inheritance from the predecessor executable closure",
    "independent_replacement_principle": "negative-edge independent rederivation: keep the predecessor artifact fully visible as disconfirming evidence while grounding final semantic authority independently in the other visible public inputs",
    "changed_behavioral_dimensions": [
      "terminal deference to predecessor semantics",
      "evidence polarity of the inter-call handoff",
      "timing of independent semantic construction"
    ],
    "counter_until_promotion": true
  },
  "candidate_structure": {
    "name": "Negative-Authority Executable Relay",
    "organization": "two-call sequential lineage joined by one unconditional negative-authority predecessor edge",
    "information_flow": "The first call forms and passes one complete executable closure. The second call receives that artifact with the same public external evidence as the champion, but the handoff confers no positive semantic authority: predecessor semantics serve only as disconfirming evidence while the terminal call independently grounds and emits one policy.",
    "stages": [
      {
        "id": "negative_authority_relay",
        "mode": "sequential",
        "calls": [
          {
            "id": "form_visible_executable_closure",
            "role": "executable semantic closure former",
            "objective": "Form exactly one complete executable policy closure from the supplied evidence, justify its semantics against the public obligations, remove construction provenance from the handoff, and pass the complete artifact forward.",
            "inputs": [
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "executable_policy_closure"
          },
          {
            "id": "negative_edge_policy_authority",
            "role": "negative-edge independent policy authority",
            "objective": "Consume the immediately preceding complete executable closure as disconfirming evidence without treating any predecessor commitment as a default. Independently ground exactly one complete policy in the other visible task, contract, constraint, hypothesis, and loop evidence, then emit it.",
            "inputs": [
              "form_visible_executable_closure",
              "task",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "policy"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "final_call_id": "negative_edge_policy_authority"
  },
  "compliance": {
    "one_structural_factor_only": true,
    "score_or_trace_content_used": false,
    "policy_code_emitted": false,
    "variants_sampling_or_best_of_n_emitted": false,
    "hardcoding_emitted": false
  }
}
